svg.aria-label: Blaž Čulina. Software Engineer at Sportradar, formerly NSoft. Java, Spring, Kubernetes, Kafka, PostgreSQL. Contribution grid, one row per year since 2022, refreshed daily. Portrait in halftone dots. About: Software engineer at Sportradar (formerly NSoft), based between Imotski, Croatia and Mostar, Bosnia and Herzegovina. Backend specialist: four years of production Java, Spring and Kubernetes behind real-time betting games, where a wrong answer costs money. I plan work as carefully as I build it, and around that core I cover a lot of ground. If it has to ship, I learn it and ship it. Experience. Full-time: Sportradar (formerly NSoft), Mostar. Software Engineer, October 2022 to now, four years and counting. Backend services for real-time betting games: game logic, ticket processing, settlement, and the feed systems that supply them. Kubernetes operators and Helm-based deployment tooling for game services. Planning and sequencing delivery across services: scoping, specs, and getting things to production. Freelance, part-time alongside the role. Backend: Cardano DEX and launchpad, VyFinance, TMinusOne, 2025. Web: WordPress sites, for clients, over the years; Custom plugins, tailored to what each client needed; Webshops, built and handed over. Technical scope, deepest areas first. Backend: Java, Spring Boot, service design, APIs, data modelling. AI tooling: Daily agent usage and research, superpowers contributor. Planning: Scoping, specs, sequencing the build, shipping. Platform: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions. Data: PostgreSQL, Kafka, Flyway, Testcontainers. Systems: Linux, Bash, Python for tooling, Rust at patch level. Blockchain: Cardano, Blockfrost, from two contracts. Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, a deliberate focus for 2026. Elsewhere. Open source: Patches upstream when something I use is broken: pop-os/freedesktop-icons (Rust), obra/superpowers. Homelab: Self-hosted Kubernetes on a private network, partly on Raspberry Pis, for testing configuration and behaviour before it reaches anything that matters. Education: FSRE, University of Mostar, Bachelor's degree, Computer Science. Languages: Croatian (native), English (full professional), German (limited working). Otherwise: Tinkering with hardware and software, making music, exploring side projects.
